heroLead: Mount Morris sits so close to the West Virginia line that Dunkard Creek, which runs right past the community, actually crosses the border before it's done, and the Marcellus play doesn't care about that line either.
intro: Greene County's southern tip, where Mount Morris sits, has been developed heavily on both the Pennsylvania and West Virginia sides of the border, with operators treating the geology as continuous rather than stopping at a state line. If your family holds mineral rights here, it's worth knowing that the rules governing your interest, including Pennsylvania's royalty protections, are specific to which side of the line your deed sits on.
We buy mineral and royalty interests around Mount Morris directly. We confirm exactly where your parcel sits and what law governs it before making any offer.

sections.heading: Border Geology, Different Rules
paragraphs: The Marcellus formation runs continuously beneath the Pennsylvania-West Virginia line, but the legal protections for mineral owners differ meaningfully between the two states. Pennsylvania's Guaranteed Minimum Royalty Act, for example, applies only to Pennsylvania leases, so confirming your parcel's exact location and governing law is a real first step, not a formality.

Southern Greene County has been drilled extensively over the past fifteen years, and Mount Morris-area units have generally seen strong, sustained production given the depth and quality of the shale in this part of the county.

sections.heading: Tracing Title Along Dunkard Creek
paragraphs: We research your chain of title through the Greene County Recorder of Deeds in Waynesburg, paying particular attention to older surveys along Dunkard Creek that sometimes reference boundaries loosely relative to the state line itself.
If your family's deed history involves land near the border, we'll confirm state jurisdiction clearly before discussing terms.

sections.heading: Act 13 Impact Fees in Perspective
paragraphs: Greene County has collected meaningful Act 13 impact fee revenue tied to well activity, which has funded real local infrastructure. We keep that separate from our discussion of your individual royalty interest, since the two are related but distinct.
